label.en: staff officer to Prince Jian'an's secretariat
director of the palace at the Secretariat
seizure and delivery to the tribunal
charged with neglecting Yang and burial

value.manner: unburied by Biao; buried by nun

units.zh: 謝超宗
units.en: Xie Chaozong
units.literal: Xie Chaozong

units.zh: 謝超宗，陳郡陽夏人也。
units.en: Xie Chaozong was a man of Yangxia in Chen commandery.
units.literal: Xie Chaozong was a native of Yangxia in Chen commandery.

units.zh: 祖靈運，宋臨川內史。
units.en: His grandfather Lingyun had been Song governor of Linchuan.
units.literal: His grandfather Lingyun was Song grand administrator of Linchuan.

units.zh: 父鳳，元嘉中坐靈運事，同徙嶺南，早卒。
units.en: His father Feng, in the Yuanjia era was exiled to Lingnan with Lingyun and died young.
units.literal: His father Feng, in the Yuanjia era because of Lingyun's affair was exiled to Lingnan together with him and died early.

units.zh: 超宗元嘉末得還。
units.en: Chaozong returned home at the end of the Yuanjia reign.
units.literal: Chaozong was able to return at the end of Yuanjia.

units.zh: 與慧休道人來往，好學，有文辭，盛得名譽。
units.en: He kept company with the monk Huixiu, loved learning, wrote well, and won great renown.
units.literal: He associated with the monk Huixiu, loved learning, had literary talent, and gained great renown.

units.zh: 解褐奉朝請。
units.en: He left coarse cloth as a court gentleman attending audience.
units.literal: He left coarse cloth as court gentleman attending audience.

units.zh: 新安王子鸞，孝武帝寵子，超宗以選補王國常侍。
units.en: Prince Ziluan of Xin'an, Emperor Xiaowu's favorite son, took Chaozong as constant attendant in his household.
units.literal: Prince Ziluan of Xin'an, the Xiaowu emperor's favored son — Chaozong by selection was made constant attendant in the princedom.

units.zh: 王母殷淑儀卒，超宗作誄奏之，帝大嗟賞。
units.en: When the prince's mother Lady Yin Shuyi died, Chaozong wrote a dirge and presented it; the emperor was deeply impressed.
units.literal: When the prince's mother Lady Yin Shuyi died, Chaozong composed a dirge and presented it; the emperor greatly sighed in admiration.

units.zh: 曰：「超宗殊有鳳毛，恐靈運復出。」
units.en: He said: "Chaozong truly has phoenix plumage — I fear Lingyun has been reborn."
units.literal: He said: "Chaozong truly has phoenix down — I fear Lingyun is born again."

units.zh: 轉新安王撫軍行參軍。
units.en: He was made staff officer on the Prince of Xin'an's Pacification Army.
units.literal: He was transferred staff officer on the Pacification Army of the Prince of Xin'an.

units.zh: 泰始初，爲建安王司徒參軍事，尚書殿中郎。
units.en: At the start of Taishi he served Prince Jian'an's secretariat and was director of the palace at the Secretariat.
units.literal: At the start of Taishi he was staff officer to Prince Jian'an's secretariat, and director of the palace at the Secretariat.

units.zh: 三年，都令史駱宰議策秀才考格，五問竝得爲上，四、三爲中，二爲下，一不合與第。
units.en: In year three, bureau clerk Luo Zai proposed the examination standard for eminent scholars: five questions all top make highest grade, four or three middle, two lower, one fail earns no rank.
units.literal: In year three, bureau clerk Luo Zai deliberated the examination standard for recommending eminent scholars: in five questions all upper makes top grade, four or three middle, two lower, one failing earns no rank.

units.zh: 超宗議以爲「片辭折獄，寸言挫衆，魯史褒貶，孔《論》興替，皆無俟繁而後秉裁。
units.en: Chaozong argued: "One phrase can decide a lawsuit, one word can overturn the crowd — the Lu historian's praise and blame, the Analects on rise and fall, need no prolixity before judgment.
units.literal: Chaozong argued: "A phrase decides a case, a word defeats the crowd — the Lu historian's praise and blame, Confucius's Discourses on rise and fall, all need no prolixity before judgment is taken.

units.zh: 夫表事之淵，析理之會，豈必委牘方切治道。
units.en: The depth of memorials and the crux of analysis — must one always heap documents before the Way is served?
units.literal: The depth of memorializing affairs and the meeting-point of analysis — must one always pile documents before the Way is touched?

units.zh: 非患對不盡問，患以恒文弗奇。
units.en: The worry is not incomplete answers but flat phrasing without brilliance.
units.literal: The worry is not incomplete answers but constant wording without marvel.

units.zh: 必使一通峻正，寧劣五通而常；
units.en: If one answer must be stern and correct, better five merely adequate passes;
units.literal: If one passage must be stern and correct, better five passes that are merely adequate;

units.zh: 與其俱奇，必使一亦宜採。」
units.en: if all are brilliant, even one fine answer should count."
units.literal: if all are marvelous, even one should be taken."

units.zh: 詔從宰議。
units.en: An edict followed Luo Zai's proposal.
units.literal: An edict followed Luo Zai's proposal.

units.zh: 遷司徒主簿，丹陽丞。
units.en: He was made chief clerk of the secretariat and aide of Danyang.
units.literal: He was moved chief clerk of the secretariat and aide of Danyang.

units.zh: 建安王休仁引爲司徒記室，正員郎，兼尚書左丞中郎。
units.en: Prince Xiuren of Jian'an brought him in as Record-Office Officer for the Minister over the Masses, Regular Gentleman, and acting Left Assistant Director Gentleman in the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Prince Jian'an Xiuren took him as secretariat recorder, regular gentleman, and acting left director of the Secretariat among the gentlemen.

units.zh: 以直言忤僕射劉康，左遷通直常侍。
units.en: Blunt speech offended Vice Director Liu Kang; he was demoted to regular attendant of unimpeded communication.
units.literal: Because blunt speech offended Vice Director Liu Kang, he was demoted regular attendant of unimpeded communication.

units.zh: 太祖爲領軍，數與超宗共屬文，愛其才翰。
units.en: When the founding emperor was Defender General they often wrote together; he cherished Chaozong's talent.
units.literal: When the founding emperor was Defender General they often composed texts together and he loved Chaozong's literary gift.

units.zh: 衞將軍袁粲聞之，謂太祖曰：「超宗開亮迥悟，善可與語。」
units.en: Defender General Yuan Can heard and told the founding emperor: "Chaozong is open, bright, and penetrating — good to talk with."
units.literal: Defender General Yuan Can heard of it and told the founding emperor: "Chaozong is open, bright, and far-seeing — pleasant to speak with."

units.zh: 取爲長史、臨淮太守。
units.en: He was made chief clerk and governor of Linhuai.
units.literal: He was taken as chief clerk and grand administrator of Linhuai.

units.zh: 粲旣誅，太祖以超宗爲義興太守，
units.en: After Can was executed the founding emperor made Chaozong governor of Yixing.
units.literal: When Can was executed the founding emperor made Chaozong grand administrator of Yixing,

units.zh: 昇明二年，坐公事免。
units.en: In the second year of Shengming, he was dismissed for a public-affairs offense.
units.literal: In the second year of Shengming, he was dismissed for a public-affairs offense.

units.zh: 詣東府門自通，其日風寒慘厲，太祖謂四座曰：「此客至，使人不衣自暖矣。」
units.en: He presented himself at the eastern mansion gate; the wind that day was bitterly cold; the founding emperor told the company: "This guest arrives and one grows warm without dressing."
units.literal: He presented himself at the eastern mansion gate; that day the wind was bitterly cold; the founding emperor told the seated company: "This guest's arrival makes one warm without putting on clothes."

units.zh: 超宗旣坐，飲酒數甌，辭氣橫出，太祖對之甚歡。
units.en: Once seated, after several cups Chaozong's eloquence burst forth; the founding emperor delighted in him.
units.literal: Chaozong having sat, after several cups his words poured forth; the founding emperor was very pleased with him.

units.zh: 板爲驃騎諮議。
units.en: He was appointed by patent adviser to the Rapid Cavalry.
units.literal: He was appointed by patent adviser to the Rapid Cavalry.

units.zh: 及卽位，轉黃門郎。
units.en: When the emperor ascended he was transferred to the yellow gate.
units.literal: When the emperor took the throne he was transferred gentleman of the yellow gate.

units.zh: 有司奏撰立郊廟歌，敕司徒褚淵、侍中謝朏、散騎侍郎孔稚珪、太學博士王咺之、總明學士劉融、何法冏、何曇秀十人竝作，超宗辭獨見用。
units.en: The responsible offices memorialized requesting that suburban and ancestral-temple hymns be composed. The emperor ordered ten men to write them: Minister over the Masses Chu Yuan, Attendant-in-Ordinary Xie Fei, Scattered Cavalry Gentleman Kong Zhigui, National University Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming Academy scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, He Tanxiu, and others. Only Chaozong's wording was used.
units.literal: The relevant office memorialized to compose suburban and temple hymns; the emperor ordered Chancellor Chu Yuan, attendant Xie Fei, attendant at leisure Kong Zhigui, Erudite Wang Xuanzhi, Zongming scholars Liu Rong, He Fajiong, and He Tanxiu — ten in all — to compose; only Chaozong's hymn was used.

units.zh: 爲人仗才使酒，多所陵忽。
units.en: He relied on talent and wine and often slighted others.
units.literal: By nature he relied on talent and drank wine, and often slighted others.

units.zh: 在直省常醉，上召見，語及北方事，超宗曰：「虜動來二十年矣，佛出亦無如何！」
units.en: In the direct offices he was often drunk; summoned to discuss the north he said: "The barbarians have stirred twenty years — even the Buddha could do nothing!"
units.literal: In the direct-service offices he was often drunk; the emperor summoned him and spoke of northern affairs; Chaozong said: "The barbarians have been stirring twenty years — even if the Buddha appeared, what could be done!"

units.zh: 以失儀出爲南郡王中軍司馬。
units.en: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor to the Prince of Nanjun.
units.literal: For breach of decorum he was sent out as army supervisor of the Prince of Nanjun.

units.zh: 超宗怨望，謂人曰：「我今日政應爲司驢。」
units.en: Chaozong resented it and said: "Today I ought to be Director of Mules."
units.literal: Chaozong resented it and told others: "Today I ought rightly to be Director of Mules."

units.zh: 爲省司所奏，以怨望免官，禁錮十年。
units.en: The provincial office memorialized; for resentful speech he was dismissed and confined ten years.
units.literal: The provincial office memorialized; for resentful speech he was dismissed and confined ten years.

units.zh: 司徒褚淵送湘州刺史王僧虔，閣道壞，墜水；
units.en: Chancellor Chu Yuan saw off Xiang governor Wang Sengqian; the gallery bridge broke and Yuan fell into the water;
units.literal: Chancellor Chu Yuan saw off Xiang governor Wang Sengqian; the gallery bridge broke and Yuan fell into the water;

units.zh: 僕射王儉嘗牛驚，跣下車。
units.en: Vice Director Wang Jian's ox once bolted and he leapt from the carriage barefoot.
units.literal: Vice Director Wang Jian once when his ox bolted leapt from the carriage barefoot.

units.zh: 超宗撫掌笑戲曰：「落水三公，墮車僕射。」
units.en: Chaozong clapped and mocked: "The third duke in the water, the vice director off his carriage."
units.literal: Chaozong clapped his hands in mockery: "The third duke who fell in the water, the vice director who fell from his carriage."

units.zh: 前後言誚，稍布朝野。
units.en: His jests and sneers gradually spread through court and town.
units.literal: Before and after, jests and sneers gradually spread through court and common.

units.zh: 世祖卽位，使掌國史，除竟陵王征北諮議參軍，領記室。
units.en: When Emperor Wu ascended he managed the national history and was adviser on the Prince of Jingling's northern campaign with charge of the records office.
units.literal: When the Shizu took the throne he was made to manage the national history, and made adviser to the Prince of Jingling's northern campaign with charge of the records office.

units.zh: 愈不得志。
units.en: He grew still more thwarted.
units.literal: He grew still more thwarted in his aims.

units.zh: 超宗娶張敬兒女爲子婦，上甚疑之。
units.en: Chaozong married his son to Zhang Jing'er's daughter; the emperor grew suspicious.
units.literal: Chaozong took Zhang Jing'er's daughter as his son's wife; the emperor was very suspicious.

units.zh: 永明元年，敬兒誅，超宗謂丹陽尹李安民曰：「往年殺韓信，今年殺彭越，尹欲何計？」
units.en: In Yongming year one, when Jing'er was executed, Chaozong told Li Anmin: "Last year Han Xin; this year Peng Yue — what will you do, Governor?"
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming, when Jing'er was executed, Chaozong told Danyang governor Li Anmin: "Last year they killed Han Xin; this year Peng Yue — what plan does the governor intend?"

units.zh: 安民具啓之。
units.en: Anmin reported everything.
units.literal: Anmin reported it fully.

units.zh: 上積懷超宗輕慢，使兼中丞袁彖奏曰：
units.en: The emperor's long resentment of Chaozong's insolence led acting censor Yuan Can to memorialize:
units.literal: The emperor's long resentment of Chaozong's insolence made him have acting censor Yuan Can memorialize, saying:

units.zh: :　　風聞征北諮議參軍謝超宗，根性浮險，率情躁薄。
units.en: It is reported that northern-campaign adviser Chaozong is by nature unstable and rash.
units.literal: It is heard that northern-campaign adviser Chaozong's root nature is floating and dangerous, his conduct rash and thin.

units.zh: 仕近聲權，務先諂狎。
units.en: Near sounding power he fawns and flatters first.
units.literal: In office he nears sounding power and is first to fawn and cozy up.

units.zh: 人裁疏黜，亟便詆賤。
units.en: When anyone barely slights him he slanders and despises them at once.
units.literal: When people barely slight him he at once slanders and despises them.

units.zh: 卒然面譽，旋而背毀。
units.en: He flatters to one's face, then slanders behind one's back.
units.literal: Suddenly he praises to the face, then slanders behind the back.

units.zh: 疑閒台賢，每窮詭舌。
units.en: He probes court worthies with crafty tongues.
units.literal: He doubts and probes platform worthies, always exhausting crafty tongues.

units.zh: 訕貶朝政，必聲凶言。
units.en: He mocks court government with vicious words.
units.literal: He mocks and belittles court government, always voicing vicious words.

units.zh: 腹誹口謗，莫此之甚；
units.en: Belly slander and open abuse — nothing surpasses this;
units.literal: Belly slander and mouth abuse — nothing surpasses this;

units.zh: 不敬不諱，罕與爲二。
units.en: irreverence and breaking taboo — rarely a second.
units.literal: irreverence and taboo-breaking — rarely a second.

units.zh: :　　輙攝白從王永先到臺辨問「超宗有何罪過，詣諸貴皆有不遜言語，竝依事列對」。
units.en: Your servant sent clerk Wang Yongxian to examine "what crimes Chaozong had — visits to the great all involved insolent speech; let him answer item by item."
units.literal: Your servant took clerk Wang Yongxian to the tribunal to examine "what crimes Chaozong had — visiting the great all used insolent speech; let him answer item by item."

units.zh: 永先列稱：「主人超宗恒行來詣諸貴要，每多觸忤，言語怨懟。
units.en: Yongxian listed: "My master constantly visits the powerful; he often offends them with resentful, raging speech.
units.literal: Yongxian listed: "My master Chaozong constantly goes to visit the great; he often gives offense, speech resentful and raging.

units.zh: 與張敬兒周旋，許結姻好，自敬兒死後，惋歎忿慨。
units.en: He dealt with Zhang Jing'er and promised marriage; after Jing'er's death he raged in resentment.
units.literal: He associated with Zhang Jing'er and promised a marriage alliance; after Jing'er died he sighed and raged in resentment.

units.zh: 今月初詣李安民，語論『張敬兒不應死』。
units.en: Early this month he told Li Anmin that Zhang Jing'er ought not to have died.
units.literal: Early this month he visited Li Anmin and discussed that Zhang Jing'er ought not to have died.

units.zh: 安民道『敬兒書疏，墨迹炳然，卿何忽作此語』？
units.en: Anmin said: 'Jing'er's letters — the evidence is clear — how can you say this?'
units.literal: Anmin said: 'Jing'er's letters and documents — the ink traces are clear — how can you suddenly speak thus?'

units.zh: 其中多有不遜之言，小人不悉盡羅縷諳憶。」
units.en: There were many insolent words; a servant cannot recall them all."
units.literal: Among them were many insolent words; a petty man cannot fully thread and remember them all."

units.zh: 如其辭列，則與風聞符同。
units.en: As listed, his words match the reports.
units.literal: As his words list, they match what was heard.

units.zh: 超宗罪自已彰，宜附常准。
units.en: Chaozong's guilt is clear; the usual standard should apply.
units.literal: Chaozong's crimes are already clear; he should follow the usual standard.

units.zh: :　　超宗少無行檢，長習民慝。
units.en: Chaozong in youth lacked conduct; in age he learned popular vices.
units.literal: Chaozong in youth had no conduct; in age he learned the people's vices.

units.zh: 狂狡之迹，聯代所疾；
units.en: Savage cunning — ages detested it;
units.literal: The traces of savage cunning — successive ages detested them;

units.zh: 迷傲之釁，累朝點觸。
units.en: reckless pride — dynasties marked it.
units.literal: the fault of reckless pride — dynasties marked it.

units.zh: 剗容掃轍，久埋世表。
units.en: He was long cast from the world's rolls.
units.literal: His countenance was swept from the road, long buried outside the world's lists.

units.zh: 屬聖明廣愛，忍禍舒慈，捨之憲外，許以改過。
units.en: When the sage showed broad mercy he was spared beyond statute and allowed to reform.
units.literal: When the sage brightness broadly loved, bearing harm and showing mercy, he was spared beyond the statutes and allowed to reform.

units.zh: 野心不悛，在宥方驕；
units.en: His wild heart did not mend; pardoned, he grew prouder;
units.literal: His wild heart did not mend; within pardon he grew prouder;

units.zh: 才性無親，處恩彌戾。
units.en: talented yet faithless — favored, he grew more perverse.
units.literal: talent and nature without kinship — in grace he grew more perverse.

units.zh: 遂遘扇非端，空生怨懟，恣囂毒於京輔之門，揚凶悖於卿守之席。
units.en: He fanned trouble and bore baseless resentment, raging at the capital's gates and violent at a governor's seat.
units.literal: He then fanned improper ends and bore resentment without cause, raging poison at the capital's gates and raising violence at a governor's seat.

units.zh: 此而不翦，國章何寄？
units.en: If this is not cut down, what remains of state law?
units.literal: If this is not cut down, to what does state law cling?

units.zh: 此而可貸，孰不可容？
units.en: If this may be pardoned, what cannot?
units.literal: If this may be pardoned, what may not be borne?

units.zh: 請以見事免超宗所居官，解領記室。
units.en: We ask that he be removed from office and relieved of the records office.
units.literal: Request that by the present affair he be removed from his posts and relieved of the records office.

units.zh: 輙勒外收付廷尉法獄治罪。
units.en: We urge he be seized and delivered to the tribunal.
units.literal: Your servant urges he be seized outside and delivered to the tribunal for punishment by law.

units.zh: 超宗品第未入簡奏，臣輙奉白簡以聞。
units.en: Chaozong's rank has not entered the brief; your servant reports by white brief.
units.literal: Chaozong's rank-grade has not entered the brief memorial; your servant ventures a white brief to report.

units.zh: 世祖雖可其奏，以彖言辭依違，大怒，使左丞王逡之奏曰：
units.en: Emperor Wu approved the memorial but was furious because Can's wording was evasive, and he had Left Assistant Director Wang Qunzhi memorialize:
units.literal: The Shizu though he approved the memorial, because Can's words were evasive, was greatly angered and had left director Wang Junzhi memorialize:

units.zh: :　　臣聞行父盡忠，無禮斯疾；
units.en: Your servant has heard: a son honors his father with full loyalty — without ritual there is rot;
units.literal: Your servant has heard that a son honors his father with full loyalty — without ritual there is disease;

units.zh: 農夫去草，見惡必耘。
units.en: the farmer uproots weeds — seeing evil he must root it out.
units.literal: the farmer uproots weeds — seeing evil he must hoe.

units.zh: 所以振纓稱良，登朝著績，未有尸位存私，而能保其榮名者也。
units.en: Therefore the upright are called good and those who serve court show merit — none cling to office for private ends and keep honor.
units.literal: Therefore he who straightens his tassel is called good and who ascends court shows merit — never has one clung to office and hoarded private ends yet kept glory and name.

units.zh: :　　今月九日，治書侍御史臣司馬侃啓彈征北諮議參軍事謝超宗，稱「根性昏動，率心險放，悖議爽眞，囂辭犯實，親朋忍聞，衣冠掩目，輙收付廷尉法獄治罪」。
units.en: On the ninth of this month, your servant Sima Kan, Reviewing Secretary and Attendant Censor, submitted an impeachment against Xie Chaozong, advisory staff officer for the Campaigning-North command, saying: "His root nature is muddled and rash; his heart is dangerous and unrestrained; his perverse arguments violate truth and his clamorous words offend fact. Kin and friends cannot bear to hear him; gentlemen cover their eyes. He should at once be arrested, delivered to the law prison of the Chamberlain for Law Enforcement, and punished for his crime."
units.literal: On the ninth of this month reviewing-secretary censor Sima Kan memorialized northern-campaign adviser Chaozong, saying "his root nature is dull and rash, heart dangerous and unrestrained, rebellious discourse offends truth, arrogant words violate fact — kin and friends cannot bear to hear, caps and gowns cover their eyes — urge seizure and delivery to the tribunal."

units.zh: 處劾雖重，文辭簡略，事入主書，被却還外。
units.en: The charge was heavy but wording brief; the chief secretariat returned it.
units.literal: The impeachment though heavy, the wording brief; the matter entered the chief secretariat and was returned outside.

units.zh: 其晚，兼御史中丞臣袁彖改奏白簡，始粗詳備。
units.en: That evening your servant Yuan Can, acting Censor-in-Chief, revised the white brief; only then was it roughly complete.
units.literal: That evening acting censor Yuan Can revised the white brief, at last roughly complete.

units.zh: 厥初隱衞，寔彖之由。
units.en: At first it was hidden — truly Can's doing.
units.literal: At first he hid and guarded — truly Can's doing.

units.zh: 尋超宗植性險戾，稟行凶詖，豺狼野心，久暴遐邇。
units.en: Chaozong's nature is dangerous, conduct vicious, wolf-heart long exposed to all.
units.literal: Chaozong's planted nature is dangerous and perverse, his endowed conduct vicious and false, wolf and jackal heart, long exposed near and far.

units.zh: 張敬兒潛圖反噬，罰未塞諐，而稱怨痛枉，形于言貌。
units.en: Zhang Jing'er plotted rebellion; punishment had not settled all guilt, yet Chaozong spoke of wrongful death openly.
units.literal: Zhang Jing'er secretly plotted rebellion; punishment had not settled the guilt, yet he spoke of grievance and wrongful death, form on face and bearing.

units.zh: 協附姦邪，疑閒勳烈，構扇異端，譏議時政，行路同忿，有心咸疾。
units.en: He clung to villains, doubted meritorious men, mocked government — travelers were angry, the upright sickened.
units.literal: He cleaved to the wicked, doubted meritorious lieges, fanned heterodox ends, mocked the times — travelers shared anger, all who had heart were ill.

units.zh: 而阿昧苟容，輕文略奏。
units.en: Yet Can fawned and tolerated, thinning the memorial.
units.literal: Yet Can fawned and tolerated, lightening text and thinning memorial.

units.zh: 又彈事舊體，品第不簡，而釁戾殊常者，皆命議親奏，以彰深愆。
units.en: By old form rank is not briefed, but extraordinary guilt requires kin to memorialize.
units.literal: By old impeachment form, rank-grade is not briefed, but where guilt is extraordinarily violent, kin are ordered to memorialize to show deep fault.

units.zh: 況超宗罪愈四凶，過窮南竹，雖下輙收，而文止黃案，沈浮旡見，輕重相乖，此而不糾，憲綱將替。
units.en: Chaozong's crime exceeds the Four Evils — though seizure was ordered, the memorial stopped at the yellow dossier; if uncorrected, law's net fails.
units.literal: Chaozong's crime exceeds the Four Evils and surpasses the Nanzhu cases — though seizure was ordered, the text stopped at the yellow dossier; float and sink unseen, light and heavy at odds — if this is not corrected, law's net will fail.

units.zh: :　　彖才識疏淺，質幹無聞，憑戚昇榮，因慈荷任。
units.en: Can's talent is shallow, substance unknown; by marriage he rose, by mercy he held office.
units.literal: Can's talent and insight are shallow, substance and stem unheard-of; by in-law he rose, by mercy he bore office.

units.zh: 不能克己厲情，少酬恩獎，撓法容非，用申私惠。
units.en: He could not restrain himself or repay grace; he bent law for private favor.
units.literal: He could not restrain himself and steel his feelings, scarcely repaying grace; he bent law to harbor wrong and show private favor.

units.zh: 何以糾正邦違，式明王度？
units.en: How can he rectify violations and display royal measure?
units.literal: How rectify the state's violations and display the king's measure?

units.zh: 臣等參議，請以見事免彖所居官，解兼御史中丞，輙攝曹依舊下禁止視事如故。
units.en: We ask Can be removed and relieved of acting censor, forbidden yet to view affairs as before.
units.literal: Your servants deliberating request that by the present affair Can be removed, relieved of acting censor, and your servant take charge to forbid him yet view affairs as before.

units.zh: :　　治書侍御史臣司馬侃雖承稟有由，而初無疑執，亦合及咎。
units.en: Your servant Sima Kan, Reviewing Secretary and Attendant Censor, had grounds for following orders, but at first he did not hold to any objection; he too should share the blame.
units.literal: Reviewing-secretary censor Sima Kan though he followed orders had at first no doubtful hold — he too should share guilt.

units.zh: 請杖督五十，奪勞百日。
units.en: Request fifty strokes and deprivation of merit for a hundred days.
units.literal: Request staff beating fifty and deprivation of merit a hundred days.

units.zh: 令史卑微，不足申盡，啓可奉行。
units.en: Clerks are lowly — the memorial may be carried out.
units.literal: Clerks are lowly — insufficient to declare fully — the memorial may be carried out.

units.zh: :　　侃奏彈之始，臣等竝卽經見加推糾，案入主書，方被却檢，疏謬之諐，伏追震悚。
units.en: At Kan's first memorial we pressed at once; the chief secretariat returned it — we are filled with dread at the looseness.
units.literal: At the start of Kan's impeachment your servants at once saw and pressed; the case entered the chief secretariat and was returned for inspection — the fault of looseness and error fills us with dread.

units.zh: 詔曰：「超宗釁同大逆，罪不容誅。
units.en: The edict said: "Chaozong's guilt equals great treason; the crime cannot be pardoned.
units.literal: The edict said: "Chaozong's guilt equals great treason; crime cannot bear pardon.

units.zh: 彖匿情欺國，愛朋罔主，事合極法，特原收治，免官如案，禁錮十年。」
units.en: Can hid facts and deceived the state — the affair fits extreme law; specially pardoned to seizure; removal as memorialized, confinement ten years."
units.literal: Can hid facts and deceived the state, loving faction and misleading the ruler — the affair fits extreme law; specially pardoned to seizure and treatment; removal as memorialized, confinement ten years."

units.zh: 超宗下廷尉，一宿髮白皓首。
units.en: Chaozong was sent to the tribunal; in one night his hair turned white.
units.literal: Chaozong was sent down to the tribunal; in one night his hair turned white.

units.zh: 詔徙越州，行至豫章，上敕豫章內史虞悰曰：「謝超宗令於彼賜自盡，勿傷其形骸。」
units.en: An edict exiled him to Yue Province. When he reached Yuzhang, the emperor ordered Yu Cong, Interior Minister of Yuzhang: "Have Xie Chaozong take his own life there; do not injure his body."
units.literal: An edict exiled him to Yue; reaching Zhang commandery the emperor issued an edict Zhang interior governor Yu Cong: "Order Chaozong to take his own life there — do not harm his body."

units.zh: 明年，超宗門生王永先又告超宗子才卿死罪二十餘條。
units.en: The next year his student Wang Yongxian reported his son Caiqing for more than twenty capital crimes.
units.literal: The next year Chaozong's student Wang Yongxian again reported Chaozong's son Caiqing for more than twenty capital crimes.

units.zh: 上疑其虛妄，以才卿付廷尉辯，以不實見原。
units.en: The emperor doubted the charges; Caiqing was tried and cleared.
units.literal: The emperor doubted the falsehood; Caiqing was given to the tribunal and cleared as untrue.

units.zh: 永先於獄自盡。
units.en: Yongxian killed himself in prison.
units.literal: Yongxian killed himself in prison.

units.zh: 劉祥
units.en: Liu Xiang
units.literal: Liu Xiang

units.zh: 劉祥字顯徵，東莞莒人也。
units.en: Liu Xiang, styled Xianzheng, was a man of Ju in Dongguan.
units.literal: Liu Xiang, styled Xianzheng, was a native of Ju in Dongguan.

units.zh: 祖式之，吳郡太守。
units.en: His grandfather Shizhi had been governor of Wu.
units.literal: His grandfather Shizhi was grand administrator of Wu.

units.zh: 父敳，太宰從事中郎。
units.en: His father Ao had been attendant gentleman of the Grand Mentor.
units.literal: His father Ao was attendant gentleman of the Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 祥宋世解褐爲巴陵王征西行參軍，歷驃騎中軍二府，太祖太尉東閣祭酒，驃騎主簿。
units.en: Under Song he was western-campaign staff officer to the Prince of Baling, served both central and rapid-cavalry staffs, sacrifice officer to the founding emperor as Grand Mentor, and rapid-cavalry chief clerk.
units.literal: In Song times Xiang left coarse cloth as western-campaign staff officer to the Prince of Baling, served both central and rapid-cavalry staffs, eastern-pavilion sacrifice officer to the founding emperor as Grand Mentor, and chief clerk to the Rapid Cavalry.

units.zh: 建元中，爲冠軍征虜功曹，爲府主武陵王曅所遇。
units.en: In Jianyuan he was merit officer on the champion's barbarian-pacification staff and was favored by Prince Zhao of Wuling.
units.literal: In the Jianyuan era he was merit officer on the champion general's barbarian-pacification staff and was favored by his lord Prince Zhao of Wuling Ye.

units.zh: 除正員外。
units.en: He was made regular outside gentleman.
units.literal: He was made regular outside gentleman.

units.zh: 祥少好文學，性韻剛疏，輕言肆行，不避高下。
units.en: Xiang in youth loved literature; he was stiff and unrestrained, speaking and acting freely without regard for rank.
units.literal: Xiang in youth loved literature; his nature was stiff and loose; he spoke lightly and acted freely, not avoiding high or low.

units.zh: 司徒褚淵入朝，以腰扇鄣日，祥從側過，曰：「作如此舉止，羞面見人，扇鄣何益？」
units.en: Chu Yuan entered court fanning the sun; Xiang passed and said: "Gestures like that — ashamed to show your face — what good is the fan?"
units.literal: Chancellor Chu Yuan entered court shading the sun with a waist fan; Xiang passed by the side and said: "Making such gestures — ashamed to show your face to people — what good is shading?"

units.zh: 淵曰：「寒士不遜。」
units.en: Yuan said: "The poor scholar lacks deference."
units.literal: Yuan said: "The cold scholar is not deferential."

units.zh: 祥曰：「不能殺袁、劉，安得免寒士？」
units.en: Xiang said: "You could not kill Yuan Can and Liu — how are you not a cold scholar?"
units.literal: Xiang said: "Unable to kill Yuan and Liu — how can you escape being a cold scholar?"

units.zh: 永明初，遷長沙王鎮軍，板諮議參軍，撰《宋書》，譏斥禪代，尚書令王儉密以啓聞，上銜而不問。
units.en: Early in Yongming he advised the Prince of Changsha's Pacification Army and compiled the Song History, mocking the abdication; Wang Jian secretly reported; the emperor resented but did not pursue it.
units.literal: At the start of Yongming he was moved to the Prince of Changsha's Pacification Army as adviser and compiled the Song History, mocking the abdication; Director Wang Jian secretly reported; the emperor harbored resentment but did not inquire.

units.zh: 歷鄱陽王征虜，豫章王大司馬諮議，臨川王驃騎從事中郎。
units.en: He served the Prince of Poyang, the Prince of Yuzhang's Grand Marshal staff, and the Prince of Linchuan's Rapid Cavalry as attendant gentleman.
units.literal: He served the Prince of Poyang's barbarian-pacification staff, the Prince of Yuzhang's Grand Marshal staff, and the Prince of Linchuan's Rapid Cavalry attendant gentleman.

units.zh: 祥兄整爲廣州，卒官，祥就整妻求還資，事聞朝廷。
units.en: His brother Zheng died as Guangzhou governor; Xiang demanded Zheng's wife return assets; the matter reached court.
units.literal: Xiang's elder brother Zheng was in Guangzhou and died in office; Xiang demanded return of assets from Zheng's wife; the matter reached court.

units.zh: 於朝士多所貶忽。
units.en: He slighted many court gentlemen.
units.literal: Toward court gentlemen he was much deprecating and slighting.

units.zh: 王奐爲僕射，祥與奐子融同載，行至中堂，見路人驅驢，祥曰：「驢！
units.en: Wang Huan was vice director; Xiang rode with Huan's son Rong; in the middle hall they saw a man driving a donkey. Xiang said: "Donkey!
units.literal: Wang Huan was vice director; Xiang rode with Huan's son Rong; reaching the middle hall they saw a passerby driving a donkey. Xiang said: "Donkey!

units.zh: 汝好爲之，如汝人才，皆已令僕。」
units.en: Keep at it — men of your talent are already all servants."
units.literal: You do well to do this — men of talent like you are already all made servants."

units.zh: 著《連珠》十五首以寄其懷。
units.en: He composed fifteen Linked Pearls to voice his feelings.
units.literal: He composed fifteen Linked Pearls to lodge his feelings.

units.zh: 辭曰：
units.en: The text says:
units.literal: The text says:

units.zh: :　　蓋聞興教之道，無尚必同；
units.en: It is said the way to raise teaching has nothing loftier than unity;
units.literal: It is said that the way to raise teaching has nothing loftier than sameness;

units.zh: 拯俗之方，理貴袪弊。
units.en: the method to save custom honors removing harm.
units.literal: the method to save custom — principle honors removing harm.

units.zh: 故揖讓之禮，行乎堯舜之朝；
units.en: Therefore yielding was practiced in Yao and Shun's court;
units.literal: Therefore the rites of yielding were practiced in Yao and Shun's court;

units.zh: 干戈之功，盛於殷周之世。
units.en: the merit of arms flourished in Yin and Zhou.
units.literal: the merit of weapons flourished in the Yin and Zhou age.

units.zh: 清風以長物成春，素霜以凋嚴戒節。
units.en: Pure wind makes spring through growth; white frost warns through decay.
units.literal: Pure wind forms spring through long things; white frost sets stern warning through withering.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞鼓鼖懷音，待揚桴以振響；
units.en: A great drum holds its sound until the drumstick rises and makes it ring;
units.literal: The great drum holds sound within, awaiting the raised drumstick to make it resound;

units.zh: 天地涵靈，資昏明以垂位。
units.en: Heaven and earth harbor numinous power, relying on darkness and light to establish their order.
units.literal: Heaven and earth contain numinous power, relying on darkness and light to establish their positions.

units.zh: 是以俊乂之臣，借湯、武而隆；
units.en: Thus worthy ministers rose to greatness through King Tang and King Wu;
units.literal: Therefore worthy ministers borrow Tang and Wu to rise;

units.zh: 英達之君，假伊、周而治。
units.en: and enlightened rulers governed with the aid of Yi Yin and the Duke of Zhou.
units.literal: and enlightened rulers rely on Yi and Zhou to govern.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞懸饑在歲，式羨藜藿之飽；
units.en: I have heard that in a year of looming famine, even wild greens seem a feast;
units.literal: I have heard that when hunger hangs over the year, one longs to be filled with wild greens;

units.zh: 重炎灼體，不念狐白之溫。
units.en: and when oppressive heat scorches the body, no one longs for a warm white-fox robe.
units.literal: when fierce heat scorches the body, one does not think of the warmth of white fox fur.

units.zh: 故才以偶時爲劭；
units.en: Thus talent wins esteem by answering the needs of its age;
units.literal: Therefore talent is esteemed by meeting its time;

units.zh: 道以調俗爲尊。
units.en: and the Way earns honor by reforming prevailing customs.
units.literal: and the Way is honored by regulating custom.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞習數之功，假物可尋；
units.en: I have heard that mastered techniques can be traced through the tools they leave behind;
units.literal: I have heard that the achievement of practiced techniques can be pursued through objects;

units.zh: 探索之明，循時則缺。
units.en: but penetrating insight fades with the passing of its age.
units.literal: but the clarity of probing inquiry diminishes as time passes.

units.zh: 故班匠日往，繩墨之伎不衰；
units.en: Thus master craftsmen pass away, while the arts of compass and inkline endure;
units.literal: Therefore master craftsmen depart day by day, yet the skill of compass and inkline does not decline;

units.zh: 大道常存，機神之智永絕。
units.en: the Way remains, yet its most inspired understanding can vanish forever.
units.literal: the Way always remains, yet wisdom of numinous workings is forever cut off.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞理定於心，不期俗賞；
units.en: I have heard that one whose convictions are settled within does not wait for popular praise;
units.literal: I have heard that when principle is settled in the heart, one does not await vulgar reward;

units.zh: 情貫於時，無悲世辱。
units.en: and one whose purpose reaches beyond his age does not mourn worldly humiliation.
units.literal: when feeling penetrates one's age, one does not grieve over worldly disgrace.

units.zh: 故芬芳各性，不待汨渚之哀；
units.en: Thus virtue gives off its own fragrance without borrowing Qu Yuan's lament by the Miluo;
units.literal: Therefore each nature carries its own fragrance, without awaiting the lament at the Miluo islet;

units.zh: 明白爲寶，無假荊南之哭。
units.en: and integrity is treasure enough without borrowing a lament from southern Chu.
units.literal: clarity itself is a treasure, without borrowing the weeping south of Jing.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞百仞之臺，不挺陵霜之木；
units.en: I have heard that a tower a hundred ren high may bear no frost-defying tree;
units.literal: I have heard that a terrace a hundred ren high does not produce trees that withstand frost;

units.zh: 盈尺之泉，時降夜光之寶。
units.en: while a spring only a foot deep may yield a night-shining pearl.
units.literal: while a spring only a foot deep may sometimes yield a luminous jewel.

units.zh: 故理有大而乖權；
units.en: Thus a grand principle may fail the demands of circumstance;
units.literal: Therefore principle may be great yet conflict with expediency;

units.zh: 物有微而至道。
units.en: while something slight may still accord with the Way.
units.literal: and a thing may be slight yet attain the Way.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞忠臣赴節，不必在朝；
units.en: I have heard that loyal ministers need not stand at court to give their lives for principle;
units.literal: I have heard that loyal ministers who give themselves for integrity need not be at court;

units.zh: 列士匡時，義存則幹。
units.en: and worthy men act to set their age right whenever duty calls.
units.literal: ranked gentlemen who rectify their age act whenever righteousness is present.

units.zh: 故包胥垂涕，不荷肉食之謀；
units.en: Thus Shen Baoxu wept for Chu though he held no place among its high ministers;
units.literal: Therefore Shen Baoxu shed tears without bearing the plans of those who ate meat;

units.zh: 王歜投身，不主廟堂之算。
units.en: and Wang Chu gave his life though he had no hand in the councils of state.
units.literal: Wang Chu cast away his life without directing calculations in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞智出乎身，理無或困；
units.en: I have heard that insight arising from within may find no obstacle;
units.literal: I have heard that when wisdom issues from oneself, principle may be without impediment;

units.zh: 聲係於物，才有必窮。
units.en: but talent tied to outward circumstances must eventually meet its limit.
units.literal: but when reputation is tied to external things, talent must reach an end.

units.zh: 故陵波之羽，不能淨浪；
units.en: Thus even wings that skim the waves cannot calm them;
units.literal: Therefore wings that cross the waves cannot make the waters still;

units.zh: 盈岫之木，無以輟風。
units.en: and forests filling the hills cannot stop the wind.
units.literal: and trees filling the mountain hollows cannot make the wind cease.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞良寶遇拙，則奇文不顯；
units.en: I have heard that a fine treasure in clumsy hands cannot reveal its marvelous pattern;
units.literal: I have heard that when a fine treasure meets clumsiness, its marvelous pattern is not displayed;

units.zh: 達士逢讒，則英才滅耀。
units.en: and when an accomplished man meets slander, his brilliance is snuffed out.
units.literal: when an accomplished man encounters slander, the brilliance of his talent is extinguished.

units.zh: 故墜葉垂蔭，明月爲之隔輝；
units.en: Thus fallen leaves may cast a shade that dims the bright moon;
units.literal: Therefore fallen leaves hang their shade, and the bright moon is cut off from radiance;

units.zh: 堂宇留光，蘭燈有時不照。
units.en: and even in a light-filled hall, an orchid lamp may fail to shine.
units.literal: a hall retains light, yet an orchid lamp sometimes fails to illuminate.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞迹慕近方，必勢遺於遠大；
units.en: I have heard that whoever confines his path to what lies near loses the power to reach what is distant and great;
units.literal: I have heard that when one's tracks seek nearby methods, one's momentum must neglect the distant and great;

units.zh: 情係驅馳，固理忘於肥遯。
units.en: and whoever is consumed by bustling ambition forgets the wisdom of withdrawal.
units.literal: when one's feelings are bound to haste and striving, one surely forgets the principle of ample withdrawal.

units.zh: 是以臨川之士，時結羨網之悲；
units.en: Thus a man beside the river may only weave the net of longing;
units.literal: Therefore men standing by the river sometimes knot the sorrowful net of envy;

units.zh: 負肆之氓，不抱屠龍之歎。
units.en: while a market peddler has no cause to lament the useless art of slaying dragons.
units.literal: while the commoner leaning on his stall does not harbor the sigh of the dragon-slayer.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞數之所隔，雖近則難；
units.en: I have heard that those divided by fate may find union hard even when near;
units.literal: I have heard that what fate separates is difficult even when near;

units.zh: 情之所符，雖遠則易。
units.en: while kindred spirits find accord easy even from afar.
units.literal: what feeling accords with is easy even when far.

units.zh: 是以陟歎流霜，時獲感天之誠；
units.en: Thus a lament could once bring down frost and prove a sincerity that moved Heaven;
units.literal: Therefore a lament that brought down frost could reveal sincerity enough to move Heaven;

units.zh: 泣血從刑，而無悟主之智。
units.en: yet another might weep blood on the way to punishment without possessing the wisdom to awaken his ruler.
units.literal: yet one might weep blood while submitting to punishment and lack the wisdom to awaken the ruler.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞妙盡於識，神遠則遺；
units.en: I have heard that the subtlest worth depends on recognition, and what is too remote in spirit goes unseen;
units.literal: I have heard that subtlety is exhausted in recognition; when spirit is remote, it is overlooked;

units.zh: 功接於人，情微則著。
units.en: while achievement touches people, and even the faintest feeling then becomes visible.
units.literal: achievement joins with people; when feeling is minute, it becomes manifest.

units.zh: 故鍾鼓在堂，萬夫傾耳；
units.en: Thus when bells and drums sound in the hall, ten thousand men turn to listen;
units.literal: Therefore when bells and drums are in the hall, ten thousand men incline their ears;

units.zh: 大道居身，有時不遇。
units.en: yet the Way may dwell in a person and still go unrecognized.
units.literal: but when the Way dwells in one person, there are times it is not encountered.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞列草深岫，不改先冬之悴；
units.en: I have heard that grasses hidden deep in the hills cannot escape the withering laid on them by winter;
units.literal: I have heard that grasses arrayed in deep mountain hollows do not change the withering of the previous winter;

units.zh: 植松澗底，無奪後凋之榮。
units.en: while a pine rooted in a ravine does not lose the honor of staying green to the last.
units.literal: a pine planted at the bottom of a ravine is not deprived of the glory of withering last.

units.zh: 故展禽三黜，而無下愚之譽；
units.en: Thus Zhan Qin was dismissed three times without earning a fool's disgrace;
units.literal: Therefore Zhan Qin was dismissed three times, yet had no reputation for utter folly;

units.zh: 千秋一時，而無上智之聲。
units.en: though across a thousand years, neither did he win renown as the wisest of men.
units.literal: a thousand autumns may be one moment, yet there was no reputation for highest wisdom.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞希世之寶，違時則賤；
units.en: I have heard that even a treasure rare in the world is despised when it does not suit its age;
units.literal: I have heard that a treasure rare in the world becomes cheap when it opposes its time;

units.zh: 偉俗之器，無聖必淪。
units.en: and an extraordinary talent must sink into obscurity when no sage recognizes him.
units.literal: an extraordinary vessel of its age must sink if there is no sage.

units.zh: 故鳴玉黜於楚岫，章甫窮於越人。
units.en: Thus ringing jade was discarded in the hills of Chu, and formal caps found no use among the people of Yue.
units.literal: Therefore sounding jade was cast out among the peaks of Chu, and ceremonial caps came to an end among the people of Yue.

units.zh: :　　蓋聞聽絕於聦，非疾響所握；
units.en: I have heard that no thunderous sound can reach ears closed by deafness;
units.literal: I have heard that when hearing is cut off by deafness, no rushing sound can seize it;

units.zh: 神閉於明，非盈光所燭。
units.en: and no flood of light can open eyes sealed by blindness.
units.literal: when spirit is closed by blindness, no fullness of light can illuminate it.

units.zh: 故破山之雷，不發聾夫之耳；
units.en: Therefore mountain-breaking thunder does not start the deaf man's ear;
units.literal: bright night's glow does not open the blind elder's eye.

units.zh: 朗夜之輝，不開矇叟之目。
units.en: Bright night's glow does not open the blind elder's eyes.
units.literal: Bright night's glow does not open the blind elder's eyes.

units.zh: 有以祥《連珠》啓上者，上令御史中丞任遐奏曰：「祥少而狡異，長不悛徙，請謁絕於私館，反脣彰於公庭，輕議乘輿，歷貶朝望，肆醜無避，縱言自若。
units.en: Someone presented Xiang's Linked Pearls to the emperor; the emperor ordered censor Ren Xia to memorialize: "Xiang from youth was cunning and strange, in age unrepentant; private visits, public back talk; he slighted the throne and mocked court figures without restraint.
units.literal: Someone presented Xiang's Linked Pearls to the emperor; the emperor ordered reviewing censor Ren Xia to memorialize: "Xiang from youth was cunning and strange, in age unrepentant; visits ended at private lodges, back talk showed in public halls; lightly discussing the imperial carriage, repeatedly deprecating court hope; venting ugliness without avoidance, letting words run as they would.

units.zh: 厥兄浮櫬，天倫無一日之悲，南金弗獲，嫂姪致其輕絕，孤舟敻反，存沒相捐，遂令暴客掠奪骸柩，行路流歎，有識傷心。
units.en: His brother's coffin floated — no kin grief; he fought his sister-in-law for goods; living and dead abandoned — robbers plundered the coffin; travelers sighed, the knowing were wounded.
units.literal: His elder brother floated the coffin — one day of human kinship without grief; southern gold not obtained — sister-in-law and nephew met his light severance; lone boat far returned — living and dead abandoned each other — thus violent guests plundered the coffin; travelers sighed; the knowing were wounded.

units.zh: 攝祥門生孫狼兒列『祥頃來飲酒無度，言語闌逸，道說朝廷，亦有不遜之語，實不避左右，非可稱紙墨。
units.en: Student Sun Lang'er listed: 'Xiang drinks without limit, speech reckless, discusses court with insolent words, not fit for record.
units.literal: Your servant took Xiang's student Sun Lang'er's list: 'Xiang of late drinks without limit, words reckless and excessive, speaks of court — also insolent words, truly not avoiding bystanders, not fit for paper and ink.

units.zh: 兄整先爲廣州，於職喪亡，去年啓求迎喪，還至大雷，聞祥與整妻孟爭計財物瞋忿，祥仍委前還，後未至鵲頭，其夜遭劫，內人竝爲凶人所淫略』。
units.en: Brother Zheng died in Guangzhou; Xiang fought Zheng's wife Meng over goods, abandoned the coffin, and later met robbery where household members were violated.'
units.literal: Elder brother Zheng was first in Guangzhou and died in office; last year he memorialized to bring the coffin; returning to Dalei he heard Xiang and Zheng's wife Meng contending over goods in rage; Xiang then left the coffin and did not come; later he did not reach Que'tou — that night met robbery and inner people were all violated by villains.'

units.zh: 如所列與風聞符同。
units.en: As listed it matches reports.
units.literal: As listed it matches what was heard.

units.zh: 請免官付廷尉。」
units.en: Request removal and delivery to the tribunal."
units.literal: Request removal from office and delivery to the tribunal."

units.zh: 上別遣敕祥曰：「卿素無行檢，朝野所悉。
units.en: The emperor separately issued an edict to Xiang: "You have long lacked conduct — known to all.
units.literal: The emperor separately issued an edict to Xiang: "You from of old had no conduct — known to court and common.

units.zh: 輕棄骨肉，侮蔑兄嫂，此是卿家行不足，乃無關他人。
units.en: You abandoned kin and insulted your sister-in-law — your family's failing, not others' affair.
units.literal: Lightly abandoning flesh and bone, insulting elder brother's wife — this is your family's insufficient conduct, not others' affair.

units.zh: 卿才識所知，蓋何足論。
units.en: The talent you possess — how is it worth discussion?
units.literal: The talent and insight you know — how is it worth discussion?

units.zh: 位涉清途，於分非屈。
units.en: Your rank touched the clear path — not bent in allotment.
units.literal: Your rank touched the clear path — in allotment not bent.

units.zh: 何意輕肆口噦，詆目朝士，造席立言，必以貶裁爲口實。
units.en: Why vent your mouth and sneer at court gentlemen, always deprecating as habit?
units.literal: Why lightly vent your mouth and sneer at court gentlemen, making seats and standing speech — must depreciation be the mouth's substance?

units.zh: 冀卿年齒已大，能自感厲，日望悛革。
units.en: I hoped age would make you reform; I looked for repentance daily.
units.literal: I hoped your years were already great and you could reform yourself; day by day I looked for repentance.

units.zh: 如此所聞，轉更增甚，諠議朝廷，不避尊賤，肆口極辭，彰暴物聽。
units.en: Reports grow worse, clamoring in court, not avoiding rank, speech to the extreme, exposing violence to all who hear.
units.literal: Such reports as heard grow worse, clamor in court, not avoiding noble or base, venting words to the extreme, exposing violence to all who hear.

units.zh: 近見卿影《連珠》，寄意悖慢，彌不可長。
units.en: Recently your Linked Pearls — intent rebellious and slow, unbearable.
units.literal: Recently seeing your Linked Pearls — intent rebellious and slow, more cannot be borne.

units.zh: 卿不見謝超宗，其才地二三，故在卿前，事殆是百分不一。
units.en: Have you not seen Xie Chaozong? His talent stands two or three ranks above yours — yet his case was perhaps one hundredth unlike yours.
units.literal: Have you not seen Xie Chaozong? His talent and standing are two or threefold yours — he stands before you — the affair is perhaps one percent unlike you.

units.zh: 我當原卿性命，令卿萬里思諐。
units.en: I will spare your life and send you far away to reflect on your faults.
units.literal: I shall spare your life and let you reflect on faults ten thousand li away.

units.zh: 卿若能改革，當令卿得還。」
units.en: If you can reform, you may return."
units.literal: If you can reform, I shall let you return."

units.zh: 獄鞫祥辭。
units.en: The tribunal examined Xiang's defense.
units.literal: The prison examined Xiang's words.

units.zh: 祥對曰：「被問『少習狡異，長而不悛，頃來飲酒無度，輕議乘輿，歷貶朝望，每肆醜言，無避尊賤』。
units.en: Xiang replied: "Asked about cunning youth, unrepentant age, drunkenness, slighting the throne, mocking court figures, venting ugliness without regard to rank.'
units.literal: Xiang replied: "Questioned: 'from youth learned cunning and strangeness, in age unrepentant; of late drinks without limit, lightly discusses the imperial carriage, deprecates court hope, each time vents ugliness without avoiding noble or base.'

units.zh: 迂答奉旨。
units.en: He answered evasively as ordered.
units.literal: Circuitous answer following the charge.

units.zh: 囚出身入官，二十餘年，沈悴草萊，無明天壤。
units.en: Your prisoner entered office twenty-odd years from coarse cloth, sunk in hardship without heaven's clarity.
units.literal: Your prisoner left coarse cloth and entered office twenty-odd years, sunk in hardship in the grass and fields, without heaven-and-earth's clarity.

units.zh: 皇運初基，便蒙抽擢，祭酒主簿，竝皆先朝相府。
units.en: When the new dynasty was first established, I was promptly promoted, serving as Libationer and Chief Clerk in the former dynasty's chancellery.
units.literal: When the imperial destiny was first established, I was promptly selected and promoted; my posts as Libationer and Chief Clerk were both in the former dynasty's chancellery.

units.zh: 聖明御宇，榮渥彌隆，諮議中郎，一年再澤。
units.en: Now that Your enlightened Majesty rules the realm, imperial favor has grown still greater: as a consultant and palace gentleman, I received grace twice in a single year.
units.literal: Now that Your enlightened Majesty rules the realm, imperial favor has grown still greater; as a consultant and palace gentleman, I received grace twice in a single year.

units.zh: 廣筵華宴，必參末列，朝半問訊，時奉天暉。
units.en: At grand banquets and splendid feasts, I was always admitted among the last ranks; at the court's semi-monthly audiences, I sometimes beheld the imperial radiance.
units.literal: At broad banquets and splendid feasts, I always joined the last rank; at the court's semi-monthly audiences, I sometimes received the heavenly radiance.

units.zh: 囚雖頑愚，豈不識恩？
units.en: Though I am foolish and obtuse, how could I fail to recognize this favor?
units.literal: Though your prisoner is stubborn and foolish, how could he not recognize this favor?

units.zh: 有何怨望，敢生譏議？
units.en: What resentment could I harbor that I would dare make mocking criticisms?
units.literal: What resentment could I harbor that I would dare give rise to mocking criticism?

units.zh: 囚歷府以來，伏事四王：武陵功曹，凡涉二載；
units.en: Since I began serving on princely staffs, I have attended four princes: two years as merit officer to the Prince of Wuling;
units.literal: Since your prisoner began serving on princely staffs, he has attended four princes: as merit officer to the Prince of Wuling, for two years in all;

units.zh: 長沙諮議，故經少時；
units.en: a short time as consultant to the Prince of Changsha;
units.literal: a short time as consultant to the Prince of Changsha;

units.zh: 奉隷大司馬，竝被恩拂，驃騎中郎，親職少日；
units.en: then under the Grand Marshal, where I received gracious treatment, and as Palace Gentleman in the Cavalry command, where I held a trusted post for only a few days;
units.literal: then in service under the Grand Marshal, where I received gracious treatment, and as Palace Gentleman in the Cavalry command, where I held a trusted post for only a few days;

units.zh: 臨川殿下不遺蟲蟻，賜參辭華。
units.en: The Prince of Linchuan did not disdain one as low as an insect, but allowed me to join his literary circle.
units.literal: The Prince of Linchuan did not cast aside one as low as an insect, but granted me a place among men of letters.

units.zh: 司徒殿下文德英明，四海傾屬。
units.en: The Prince of Jingling, serving as Minister over the Masses, is brilliant in civil virtue, and all within the four seas turn toward him.
units.literal: The Prince of Jingling, serving as Minister over the Masses, is brilliant in civil virtue, and all within the four seas incline toward him.

units.zh: 囚不涯卑遠，隨例問訊，時節拜覲，亦沾眄議。
units.en: Though I knew myself lowly and distant, I followed precedent in paying my respects, attending audiences at the seasons, and sometimes received a glance and a word.
units.literal: Your prisoner did not measure how lowly and distant he was; following precedent, he paid his respects, attended audiences at the seasons, and sometimes received a glance and a word.

units.zh: 自餘令王，未被祗拜，旣不經伏節，理無厚薄。
units.en: As for the other princes, I was never received in audience; since I never served under their standards, there was no question of partiality toward them.
units.literal: As for the other princes, I was never received in audience; since I never served beneath their standards, there was no question of favoring or slighting them.

units.zh: 敕旨制書，令有疑則啓。
units.en: Imperial edicts and statutes command that any doubt be reported.
units.literal: Imperial edicts and statutes command that whenever there is doubt, it be reported.

units.zh: 囚以天日懸遠，未敢塵穢。
units.en: Because the imperial sun hung far above, I did not dare trouble it.
units.literal: Because the imperial sun hung far above, your prisoner did not dare trouble or defile it.

units.zh: 私之疑事，衞將軍臣儉，宰輔聖朝，令望當世，囚自斷才短，密以諮儉，儉爲折衷，紙迹猶存。
units.en: In private matters that troubled me, I turned to Wang Jian, General of the Guard, chief assistant to the sacred court and a man of commanding reputation in this age. I knew my own abilities were slight, so I consulted him privately; he gave a balanced judgment, and the written record still survives.
units.literal: In private matters that troubled me, I turned to Your servant Wang Jian, General of the Guard, chief assistant to the sacred court and a man of commanding reputation in this age. I knew my own abilities were slight, so I consulted him privately; Jian gave a balanced judgment, and the written record still survives.

units.zh: 未解此理云何敢爲『歷貶朝望』。
units.en: Not understanding this — how dare he 'mock court figures'?
units.literal: Not understanding this principle — how dare he 'deprecate court hope'?

units.zh: 云囚『輕議乘輿』，爲向誰道？
units.en: Saying 'slighting the throne' — to whom did he speak?
units.literal: Saying your prisoner 'lightly discusses the imperial carriage' — to whom did he speak?

units.zh: 若向人道，則應有主甲，豈有事無髣彿，空見羅謗？
units.en: If to others there should be an accuser; how can empty slander stand without likeness?
units.literal: If he spoke to others there should be a chief accuser; how can matters be without likeness, empty slander alone?

units.zh: 囚性不耐酒，親知所悉，強進一升，便已迷醉。」
units.en: Your prisoner cannot bear wine — kin know it; one cup and he is drunk."
units.literal: Your prisoner's nature cannot bear wine — close kin know it; forced to one sheng he is already drunk."

units.zh: 其餘事事自申。
units.en: The rest he answered item by item.
units.literal: The rest he answered item by item.

units.zh: 乃徙廣州。
units.en: He was exiled to Guangzhou.
units.literal: He was then exiled to Guangzhou.

units.zh: 祥至廣州，不得意，終日縱酒，少時病卒，年三十九。
units.en: Reaching Guangzhou he was discontent, drank all day, and soon died of illness at thirty-nine.
units.literal: Xiang reaching Guangzhou was discontent, drank all day, and soon died of illness, aged thirty-nine.

units.zh: 祥從祖兄彪，祥曾祖穆之正胤。
units.en: Xiang's agnatic cousin Biao was legitimate heir of great-grandfather Muzhi.
units.literal: Xiang's agnatic elder Biao — Xiang's great-grandfather Muzhi's legitimate heir.

units.zh: 建元初，降封南康縣公，虎賁中郎將。
units.en: At Jianyuan's start he was demoted to Duke of Nankang, tiger-guard central gentleman.
units.literal: At the start of Jianyuan he was demoted and enfeoffed Duke of Nankang, tiger-guard central gentleman.

units.zh: 永明元年，坐廟墓不脩削爵。
units.en: In Yongming year one he lost rank for not repairing the ancestral temple.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming he was reduced in rank for not repairing the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 後爲羽林監。
units.en: Later he was feathered-forest supervisor.
units.literal: Later he was feathered-forest supervisor.

units.zh: 九年，又坐與亡弟母楊別居，不相料理，楊死不殯葬，崇聖寺尼慧首剃頭爲尼，以五百錢爲買棺材，以泥洹轝送葬劉墓。
units.en: In year nine he was charged with living apart from his dead brother's mother Yang and not caring for her; when Yang died he did not bury her — a nun bought a coffin for five hundred cash and sent burial to the Liu tomb.
units.literal: In year nine he was again charged with living separately from his dead younger brother's mother Yang without managing her; when Yang died he did not bury her — Chong Sheng Temple nun Huishou shaved her head as a nun; with five hundred cash bought a coffin; with a clay-wheeled hearse sent burial to the Liu tomb.

units.zh: 爲有司所奏，事寢不出。
units.en: Offices memorialized; the affair was shelved.
units.literal: The relevant office memorialized; the affair was shelved and not issued.

units.zh: 【評贊】
units.en: Comment and eulogy
units.literal: Comment and eulogy

units.zh: 史臣曰：魏文帝云「文人不護細行」，古今之所同也。
units.en: The historian says: Cao Pi said "literary men do not guard small conduct" — ancient and modern agree.
units.literal: The historian says: Wei Emperor Wen said "literary men do not guard small conduct" — ancient and modern are the same.

units.zh: 由自知情深，在物無競，身名之外，一概可蔑。
units.en: They know their feelings run deep and do not compete over material things; beyond life and reputation, everything else may be scorned.
units.literal: Because they know feeling is deep, in things they do not compete; beyond body and name — all may be scorned.

units.zh: 旣徇斯道，其弊彌流，聲裁所加，取忤人世。
units.en: Following this Way, harm flows wider; reputation takes offense at the world.
units.literal: Having followed this Way, the harm flows wider; what sound and judgment add takes offense at the worldly.

units.zh: 向之所以貴身，翻成害己。
units.en: What once honored the body turns to harm oneself.
units.literal: What once made the body honored turns to harm oneself.

units.zh: 故通人立訓，爲之而不恃也。
units.en: Therefore the wise set instruction and act without relying on it.
units.literal: Therefore the penetrating man sets instruction and acts yet does not rely on it.

units.zh: 贊曰：超宗蘊文，祖構餘芬。
units.en: Eulogy: Chaozong held literature, ancestral fragrance lingering.
units.literal: Eulogy: Chaozong stored literature, ancestors' lingering fragrance.

units.zh: 劉祥慕異，言亦不羣。
units.en: Liu Xiang admired strangeness; his words stood apart.
units.literal: Liu Xiang admired the strange; his words too stood apart.

units.zh: 違朝失典，流放南濆。
units.en: Violating court and losing canon, exiled to the southern shore.
units.literal: Violating court and losing canon, exiled to the southern shore.
